description: A 64 step sequencer of randomly generated voltages, quantized to a root and scale, with random per-cycle offsets called slips and a second modulation sequence

params.text: Sets the root note the sequence is quantized to, C through B
Sets how many steps play before the sequence returns to its starting step, 1 to 64
Picks the scale the sequence is quantized to: chromatic, major, minor, major pentatonic, minor pentatonic, dorian, lydian, mixolydian, phrygian, locrian or blues
Sets the step the sequence starts and restarts from, 1 to 64
Draws a new random sequence of 64 values
Sets the chance that a step reaches the outputs, 0 to 100%; a skipped step repeats the last voltage and puts out no gate
Sets what share of the 64 steps are given a random offset, 0 to 100%, a fresh set of steps being chosen at the start of each cycle
Draws a new random modulation sequence

inputs.text: A rising edge advances one step
0-10V sweeps the root across the twelve notes, or reads a pitch voltage with root input v/oct switched on in the menu
0-10V sets the number of steps over the whole 1 to 64 span, in place of the steps knob
A rising edge returns the sequence to its starting step
0-10V steps through the eleven scales, in place of the scale knob
0-10V sets the starting step over the whole 1 to 64 span, in place of the start knob
A rising edge draws a new random sequence of 64 values
0-10V sets the step chance over the whole 0 to 100% span, in place of the prob knob
0-10V sets the share of offset steps over the whole 0 to 100% span, in place of the slips knob
A rising edge draws a new random modulation sequence

outputs.text: The quantized voltage of the current step, with that step's random offset added where it has one
Carries the clock voltage while a step plays, and 0V while a step is skipped
Carries the clock voltage while a step that has a random offset plays, and 0V otherwise
A 100ms 10V trigger each time the sequence returns to its starting step
The voltage of the current step of the modulation sequence, over the range picked on the menu

menu: root input v/oct — makes the root cv jack read a pitch voltage, the twelve semitones of each volt picking the root, in place of a 0-10V sweep
poly channels — sets how many channels the sequence and gate outputs carry, 1 to 16, each clock pulse moving to the next channel
poly mod output — carries the mod sequence output on the same channels as the sequence output; switched off it is monophonic
remap on generate — fits the random values to their ranges as a sequence is generated; switched off the fitting happens at playback, so a range change reshapes the sequence already generated
sequence range — sets the voltage span of the sequence output: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
slip sequence range — sets the voltage span of the random offsets the slips add: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
mod sequence range — sets the voltage span of the mod sequence output: twelve presets from +/-10V to 0V-1V, or custom for a minimum and maximum of your own
quantize mod sequence — an item in the mod sequence options submenu, quantizing the mod sequence to the same root and scale as the main sequence
apply slips to mod sequence — an item in the mod sequence options submenu, adding each cycle's random offsets to the mod sequence too
apply step probability to mod sequence — an item in the mod sequence options submenu, applying the step chance to the mod sequence too
add slipspander — places a slipspander expander against the right-hand edge of the module; with one already there the menu prints slipspander connected in place of this item
